secrets.name: JWT_SECRET
secrets.description: Signs the app's JWT session cookies. Required at boot (backend/server.py reads os.environ['JWT_SECRET']).

secrets.name: ALPHA_VANTAGE_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Alpha Vantage API key (https://www.alphavantage.co/support/#api-key) for the live global cocoa price on the Cocoa Rate page. Empty means the page shows its graceful 'live price unavailable' state.
